descriptor: Pots for tax, payroll and profit

voice.summary: Orbit Ledger speaks like an unflappable finance director who gets to the point in pounds and pence. It is calm about money, exact with figures and light with metaphors.
dos: Always show the exact amount to the penny
Use British money language: tax, payroll, VAT
Say what happens automatically and when
donts: Do not promise to make anyone rich
Do not use crypto or trading slang
Do not round a tax figure

taglines: Your invoice lands, your money divides
Know what is yours to spend
boilerplate: Orbit Ledger is a business finance app whose pots for tax, payroll and profit fill automatically the moment an invoice is paid.

microcopy.success: Invoice paid. £2,400.00 moved into your pots.
microcopy.error: We could not split that payment. No money has moved.
microcopy.empty: No pots yet. Create one for tax.

logo.note: Coins in pots express money sorted into places, with the orbit in the name.
